notes.title: Dreams Of The Elements 1.10 Patch Update
notes.content: Fixed some typos as well as added a little bit of dialogue change to make more sense and flesh out the story :)  Also added an extra dialogue box or two to the content warning at the start of a new save file to be more clear on what is in the game :)
